subtitle: Autonomous AI operators for Milaha Logistics City: more volume through the same warehouses, without adding headcount.

rationale.why: Milaha has set a goal of semi- and fully automated warehousing at Logistics City and is merging shipping, ports and logistics into one platform. The bottleneck is the manual exception work between systems. Evos turns that work into autonomous AI operators trained on Milaha's own senior staff, so growth in trade volume does not mean growth in headcount.
